floater.name: plus_local_mesh
floater.title: LOCAL MESH
floater.floater.string: Click an object in the world to select it. A mesh is shown on the selected object.
The selected object is not a mesh object. A local mesh can only be shown on one (rez any mesh you own to use as a stand-in).
The selected object is a rigged mesh. Rigged meshes are not supported yet.
The selected object's own mesh has not loaded yet. Wait a moment.
floater.text: Mesh files on this PC (.dae, .gltf, .glb). Only you see them; nothing is uploaded.

scroll_list.columns.label: LODs
scroll_list.columns.name: lods
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: The LODs read from files, highest to lowest (3 2 1 0). A missing one shows the next better one. Lower LODs are files beside it named like name_LOD2.dae, name_LOD1.dae, name_LOD0.dae.

scroll_list.columns.label: Shown
scroll_list.columns.name: shown
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: Objects showing a mesh of the file

button.label: Reload
button.name: reload
button.tool_tip: Read the selected file again (after you export it again); the objects showing it get the new version

button.label: Remove
button.name: remove
button.tool_tip: Remove the selected file from the list; the objects showing it get their own mesh back

check_box.label: Reload when the file changes
check_box.name: auto_reload
check_box.tool_tip: Read a file again by itself when you export it again (checked once a second)

combo_box.name: meshes
combo_box.tool_tip: The mesh of the file to show (a file can have several)

check_box.label: Give the object the size of the file
check_box.name: file_size
check_box.tool_tip: Off: the mesh is stretched to the object's own size. On: the object takes the size the file has, in meters (only in your viewer; not for attachments).

button.label: Show on the object
button.name: show
button.tool_tip: Show the mesh on the selected object, in your viewer only. While it shows a local mesh, the object does not take changes from the region.

button.label: Take off
button.name: take_off
button.tool_tip: Give the selected object its own mesh back
